<!--
  CHAPTER TEMPLATE — integrated_bioanalytics
  ============================================
  This is the canonical skeleton for a chapter of the book. To add a chapter:

    1. Copy this file to chapters/<N>_<short_name>.Rmd  (e.g. 19_networks.Rmd)
    2. Fill in the sections below and delete these guiding comments.
    3. Register it in ../index.Rmd with a child chunk, in reading order:
         ```{r child="chapters/<N>_<short_name>.Rmd"}
         ```
       (Chapters are merged via explicit child= chunks, NOT auto-collected.)
    4. Re-render.

  Files whose names begin with "_" are not rendered, so this template never
  appears in the book.

  Standard structure — keep this order (see any existing chapter for a live example):
    1. Chapter heading            # title {#slug -}  (pin the slug: links point at <slug>.html)
    2. Opening card               ::: {.chapter-card} holding: cover image chunk, the empty
                                  cc-title-slot div (the title is moved there), ONE intro
                                  paragraph (why and when: the questions answered, no function
                                  names), the PDF and jump buttons, the decision flowchart
    3. Content sections           ## section {-}  /  ### subsection {-}  (straight after the card)
    4. <hr>
    5. Chapter summary            []{#<slug>-summary} anchor, ## chapter summary {-}, the
                                  {.summary-pdf} link to summary_sheets/<file stem>.pdf, the recap
                                  (how to do it well: decisions, traps, reading the results), then
                                  the function table. The flowchart is in the card, not here; the
                                  PDF builder fetches it from there.
    6. <hr>
    7. Exercises                  ## exercises {-}  (usually commented out)
    8. <hr>
    9. Further reading            ## further reading {-}  (3–5 annotated links)

  One job per text: see chapters/AGENTS.md, "One job per text".
  No empty `## {-}` headings: the right-hand "On this page" menu gets its two gaps (after the
  title, before the summary) from style.css, so the gaps are not clickable links.

  Conventions:
    - The {-} after every heading suppresses bookdown's automatic numbering.
    - Cite with [@bibkey]; keys live in ../book.bib, rendered with
      chicago-fullnote-bibliography.csl.
    - Default chunk options come from ../_common.R and index.Rmd; only set
      per-chunk options (fig.width, out.width, message, etc.) when needed.
-->
